messages:
mike: Quick ask — planning to scale inference fleet for a new customer POC. Need approval to buy reserved H100 capacity in us-west2. Rough ask: 8 reserved H100 equivalents, 1-yr partial commit to enable burst. Estimated commit cost: $98,400/yr vs on-demand ~ $180k/yr. Details below.
ana: Can you drop the math + assumptions? utilization %, burst pattern, and where traffic will route pls.
sasha: Would product sign off on a 1-yr? they want flexibility. Maybe do 6 committed + 2 burst spot? Finops?
mike: Assumptions: avg util 65% sustained, peak burst ~120% for short windows; model avg seq len 1024; batch sizes 8. Vendor quote used: $12,300 per H100/year for 1-yr committed. On-demand ~ $2.5/hr => ~ $21.9k/yr per GPU.
devin: We can create a "burst pool" of spot H100s in us-east1 and cross-region route cold/overflow traffic — adds ~5–8ms RTT but cuts marginal cost ~40%.
ana: If we do 6 committed + 2 spot, what's the delta vs 8 committed in cost and risk?
mike: 6 committed = $73,800/yr. 2 spot expected ~ $18k/yr (variable) so total ~ $91.8k vs $98.4k for 8 committed. Tradeoffs: spot preemptions and slightly higher operational complexity.
sasha: Can we quantify SLO impact? demos can't have >2% tail latency regressions.
devin: Auto-fallback plan: 1) route to local committed pool, 2) if saturated, route overflow to us-east1 spot pool, 3) if still saturated, spin up lightweight quantized variants on hosted nodes. Runbook exists and we have circuit-breakers + gradual rollout config.
mike: Also note: procurement offered a 2-yr term at ~10% lower annual cost but requires longer financial lock. 1-yr keeps flexibility for model/quant decisions.
finops-bot: FinOps notice: Any commit > $50k requires FP sign-off and a 2-yr justification doc. See https://redwood.internal/finops/policies
mike: Requesting approval: allocate $100k FY commitment for 1-yr split commit (6x committed H100 us-west2 + 2x spot burst us-east1). I'll attach the spreadsheet and the vendor quote in procurement PR. @ana @sasha please react if ok :thumbsup:
ana: :thumbsup: pending FP sign-off.
sasha: :thumbsup: product ok with fallback plan.
finops-bot: Reminder: Submit procurement intake PR with vendor quote + SOC checklist. Approved pending procurement intake.
